The remaining snippets concern metabolic scaling, toxicokinetics, or DEBtox lethal/sub-lethal effect modeling and do not bear on the relationship between metabolic activity and lethal DO. No snippet contradicts the fact. Overall the evidence is weak (single citation plus indirect mechanistic plausibility) with no conflicting evidence, hence low evidence strength and neutral-to-insufficient consensus.
